title: Saw Gerrera
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
franchise: Rogue One: A Star Wars story
description: Saw Gerrera began his career as a partisan on Onderon, fighting against the Separatists who had taken over his home planet. Trained in the art of combat by the Jedi during the Clone Wars, Saw Gerrera quickly set his sights as toppling the Empire. Brutal and ruthless in his method, he often found himself at odds with the burgeoning Rebellion, hiding himself away on Jeddha to fight against the Empire.
